claim: Gran Reserva: 24 months for reds, 12 months for whites and rosés
because: INV Resolución C.11/2011 originally set Gran Reserva tintos at 24 months. INV Resolución 26/2021 (Boletín Oficial, 7 January 2022), Article 7, amended Punto 1°, inciso e), apartado ii of C.11/2011 so that the minimum for Gran Reserva tintos 'pasará a ser de DIECIOCHO (18) meses'. Reserva is unchanged at 12 months for reds and 6 for whites and rosés. The 12-month figure for Gran Reserva whites and rosés is the original C.11/2011 text; the Boletín Oficial text of Article 7 amends only the red figure. So the model answer's 24 months for red Gran Reserva has been wrong since January 2022.
fix: Reserva: 12 months for reds, 6 months for whites and rosés. Gran Reserva: 18 months for reds (cut from 24 by INV Resolución 26/2021), 12 months for whites and rosés
